top_signals.title: Oil Gains, Asian Bonds Fall on Inflation Concerns: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Crude oil extended its rally and Asian bonds tracked Treasuries lower as higher energy prices fueled inflation concerns and strengthened bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Minebea Mitsumi pauses acquisitions to chase AI returns
top_signals.summary: The key supplier to Nintendo is eyeing climbing market forecasts for data centers and humanoid robots, and sees "unlimited" upside ahead.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: India wants to buy fewer Chinese imports, but keeps needing more
top_signals.summary: India has spent years trying to become less dependent on China, but it has been buying more, instead, with trade becoming more unbalanced than ever.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
